# TaskList

> Floating agent task progress pill above the composer that expands into the full task list.

This file matches the installed `task-list` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/task-list.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/task-list.md`.

## Composition

### Expandable task progress

Trigger and item children can be omitted to use their built-in content.

```tsx
<TaskList>
  <TaskListTrigger>
    <TaskListIndicator />
    <TaskListProgress />
    <TaskListLabel />
  </TaskListTrigger>
  <TaskListContent>
    <TaskListItem>
      <TaskListIndicator />
    </TaskListItem>
  </TaskListContent>
</TaskList>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import type { TaskStatus } from "@/components/control-ui/task-list";
import { TaskList, TaskListContent, TaskListItem, TaskListTrigger } from "@/components/control-ui/task-list";
import { Button } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/button";

const planSteps = [
  "Design data model + storage for projects/tasks/pomodoro",
  "Add native notification IPC handler for session completion",
  "Building projects sidebar and task list",
  "Build persistent pomodoro timer bar + timer engine",
  "Set window sizing, build, validate",
];

function statusFor(index: number, step: number): TaskStatus {
  if (index < step) return "completed";
  if (index === step) return "active";
  return "pending";
}

export function TaskListExample() {
  const [step, setStep] = useState(2);

  const isComplete = step === planSteps.length;

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto grid w-full max-w-xl gap-3">
      <TaskList defaultOpen>
        <TaskListTrigger />
        <TaskListContent>
          {planSteps.map((label, index) => (
            <TaskListItem key={label} label={label} status={statusFor(index, step)} />
          ))}
        </TaskListContent>
      </TaskList>
      <Button variant="quiet" size="sm" className="justify-self-end" onClick={() => setStep(isComplete ? 0 : step + 1)}>
        {isComplete ? "Restart plan" : "Complete current task"}
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```
